Data Movement and Conversion Instructions: ld

Syntax

ld{.weak}{.ss}{.cop}{.level::cache_hint}{.level::prefetch_size}{.vec}.type  d, [a]{.unified}{, cache_policy};

.ss =  { .const, .global, .local };
.cop =  { .ca, .cg, .cs, .lu, .cv };
.level::cache_hint = { .L2::cache_hint };
.level::prefetch_size = { .L2::64B };
.vec =  { .v2, .v4 };
.type = { .u8, .f32 };

Data Movement and Conversion Instructions: ld.global.nc

Syntax

ld.global{.cop}.nc{.level::cache_hint}{.level::prefetch_size}.type  d, [a]{, cache_policy};
ld.global.nc{.vec}.type                                          d, [a]{, cache_policy};

.cop =  { .ca, .cg, .cs };
.level::cache_hint = { .L2::cache_hint };
.level::prefetch_size = { .L2::64B };
.vec =  { .v2, .v4 };
.type = { .u8, .f32 };

Integer Arithmetic Instructions: add

add

Add integer values.

Syntax

add.type1        d, a, b;
add{.sat}.type2  d, a, b;

.type1 = { .u16, .u64, .s16, .s64 };
.type2 = { .u32, .u16x2, .u8x4, .s32, .s16x2, .s8x4 };

Description

Performs integer addition.

Floating Point Instructions: add

add

Add floating-point values.

Syntax

add{.rnd}{.ftz}{.sat}.f32  d, a, b;
add{.rnd}{.ftz}.f32x2      d, a, b;

.rnd = { .rn, .rz };

Description

Performs floating-point addition with rounding.

Mixed Precision Floating Point Instructions: add

Syntax

add{.rnd}{.sat}.cdtype.atype  d, a, c;

.rnd =   { .rn, .rz };
.cdtype = { .f32, .e5m2x2, .e5m2x4, .e4m3x2, .e4m3x4 };
.atype =  { .f16, .bf16 };

Scalar Video Instructions: vadd, vsub, vabsdiff, vmin, vmax

Syntax

vop.dtype.atype.btype{.sat}  d, a{.asel}, b{.bsel};

.vop =   { vadd, vsub, vabsdiff, vmin, vmax };
.dtype = { .u32, .s32 };
